newsitem.title: USA: Rep. Saxton - US needs to clarify rate, dlr policies.
newsitem.headline: Rep. Saxton - US needs to clarify rate, dlr policies.

text.p: The chairman of the congressional Joint Economic Committee said Monday the U.S. needs to clarify its policies on the dollar and interest rates because there may be a conflict between the two.
Rep. Jim Saxton, a New Jersey Republican, warned of a potential conflict between apparent Federal Reserve policy on interest rates and Treasury policy on the dollar.

He said in a statement the Fed is widely seen as moving toward tightening monetary policy, which would likely strengthen the dollar, while the Treasury is "signaling that a stronger dollar may be unacceptable."
"This situation seems to reflect a contradiction between Federal Reserve monetary policy and Treasury exchange rate policy," Saxton said in a statement.
"This contradiction can only lead to uncertainty and confusion and should be clarified as soon as possible," he said.
